name: Trade costs rise and helium still limits shipments
sentence: Trade rules raise costs but cut nothing off, and magnets still need helium to ship. Delivery dates depend on helium containers, the power grid and the roads rather than on trade rules.
what_happens: The truce is renewed and no part is listed. The Gulf route stays near closed and both plants buy helium on allocation, the United States plant from domestic and Canadian sources and the China plant at the back of the Asian spot queue. Conventional builds still dominate because no 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared. Both United States sites run winters under elevated grid ratings from 2027, and the helium cover thins each year because it is inventory bought at a 4 percent rate against rising prices.

path.sentence: The truce is renewed at its notice date, the Gulf route stays near closed, and a container fleet with a 35 to 48 day hold sets the helium cover at the United States plant while the Carolinas grid is rated elevated from 2027.
Conventional builds still dominate, the Midcontinent grid is rated high from the winter of 2028, and the helium cover thins each budget round as rates and input prices stay up.

what_fails_first.sentence: The United States magnet plant runs out of helium on hand first. A winter power curtailment or a flood cuts power to the liquefier and closes the trailer road while the next helium container is still in transit, and the helium on hand runs out before the delivery arrives.
what_fails_first.tag: Placeholder on the days of cover; Panel judgement on the path

how_soon: The failure comes in the winter of 2028 to 2029. A storm as severe as the 2018 inland flood could bring it forward to any hurricane season from 2027. The China plant's helium allocation queue is the second to fail, pushing Asian installs more than 30 days late in the first half of 2028.
what_it_costs: The United States magnet plant stops once for 30 to 45 days, and a quarter of Western Hemisphere installs run more than 30 days late (panel estimate). Asian installs run late on the allocation schedule. Market share does not move, because every supplier is short of helium at the same time.
what_prevents_it: Logistics keeps more days of helium on hand at the United States plant than a container's hold time plus the 10 days the grid took to rebuild after the 2024 storm. Site operations puts the liquefier on backup power separate from the plant's power feed. Both must be in place before the winter of 2028, so both start by the second quarter of 2027.

how_sure.basis: the fleet of helium containers, the hold time, the grid ratings and the allocation letters come from dated public sources, but no grid warning has yet led to a curtailment lasting weeks, the days of helium on hand are a Placeholder, and the panel split six to five on which plant fails first.

what_would_change_this: A 3 tesla sealed magnet cleared for sale, or the Gulf route reopening, moves the line toward Future 2. A United States helium allocation rule moves it toward Future 3. A confirmed figure of more than 60 days of helium on hand at the United States plant removes that failure, and the China plant's helium queue becomes the first to fail.

name: Trade costs rise and sealed magnets end the helium limit
sentence: Trade rules raise costs but cut nothing off, and by 2031 helium no longer decides whether a magnet ships. The one part that keeps every magnet cold, the cold head, then comes from a single maker.
what_happens: The truce is renewed and parts flow at a tariff cost. The Gulf route reopens and the allocation letters stop. Sealed 1.5 tesla magnets build service history and European tenders pull sealed designs. A 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared, the test draw proves to be a cylinder, and sealed designs take most new builds and the European replacement wave. The magnet is still wound from one mill's wire, and one Japanese cold head now carries the whole thermal load of every new magnet with no helium reserve behind it.

path.sentence: The truce is renewed, the Gulf route reopens to insured traffic, and sealed 1.5 tesla magnets cleared at three makers build service history while European tenders pull sealed designs.
A 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared, sealed designs take most new builds, helium becomes a service matter, and the plant floor changes trade from helium handling to vacuum and cryocooler work.

what_fails_first.sentence: Cold heads fail first. One maker supplies both new builds and the spare cold heads for installed sealed magnets, which warm up when a cold head fails, so an earthquake or a plant outage at the maker stops both magnet plants at once.
what_fails_first.tag: Panel judgement; the maker's location is AI-suggested and Engineering confirms it against the Nankai Trough zone

how_soon: The risk opens once sealed magnets pass half of output, which the panel expects in 2029, and lasts to 2031. The event itself has no schedule.
what_it_costs: Both plants stop for more than 30 days, because they share the cold head and requalifying a new source takes 18 months, longer than any inventory lasts. Installed sealed magnets that lose a cold head warm up while service and new builds compete for the part, so hospitals face a scanner that cannot run rather than a late install.
what_prevents_it: Engineering and Sourcing qualify a second cold-head maker for the sealed design before sealed magnets pass half of output, or Engineering builds in a tested hold that keeps a magnet cold for 30 days without a working cold head. Either must start by mid-2027, because requalification takes 18 months.

how_sure.basis: wire and the cold head are sole-source parts today, and the panel was most sure that this will not change by 2031. It was less sure that a cold-head outage stops the line rather than only costing money, and least sure of the date, because the trigger has no schedule.

what_would_change_this: A second cold-head maker cleared for the sealed design before 2029 means a cold-head outage costs money but stays inside the 30-day limit. A sealed-magnet test draw the size of a full helium delivery pulls this future back toward Future 1. If no 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared by 2028, this future moves beyond 2031.

name: A part is cut off and helium still limits shipments
sentence: A government cuts off a part before 2031 while magnets still need helium to ship. The stop falls on the China plant, inside a trading partner's borders, and the United States plant cannot cover for it.
what_happens: The truce lapses at its notice date and entity listings in 2027 name the China plant's logic supplier and a cryogenic parts route. The Gulf route stays near closed, so helium at both plants is bought on allocation letters. Two blocs harden. The China plant builds for Asia without United States-origin logic, the United States plant keeps shipping on allocated helium but cannot cover Asia because its ramp and test capacity is sized for one hemisphere, and payment rails and customs become a licence queue.

path.sentence: The truce lapses at its notice date, entity listings in 2027 name the China plant's logic supplier and a cryogenic parts route, and helium at both plants stays on allocation.
Two blocs harden, the China plant builds for Asia without United States-origin logic, its lanes to Japan and India run under grey-zone pressure, and payment rails split by bloc.

what_fails_first.sentence: The China plant fails first. It sits inside a trading partner's borders and holds weeks, not months, of programmable logic parts, so an entity listing of its logic supplier stops the control electronics for every system it builds.
what_fails_first.tag: AI-suggested on what the plant imports and how much it holds; Sourcing confirms

how_soon: The stop comes within one quarter of the first entity listing, inside the 2027 sourcing cycle. The panel's first estimate is the second half of 2027. An investigation under China's amended cyber law, combined with a freeze on payments, could cause the same stop sooner.
what_it_costs: The China plant stops for more than 30 days, and no other plant can cover Asia. Asian installs run more than 30 days late for two quarters or more, and market share moves in Japan and India because a China-built competitor keeps delivering. The United States plant's helium on hand runs out second, by early 2028.
what_prevents_it: Sourcing holds more logic and cold-head stock at the China plant than the export license queue takes to clear, bought before the truce notice date. Engineering qualifies a source of logic parts that does not originate in the United States for the Asian build, starting by the first quarter of 2027.

how_sure.basis: the listing tools exist and were used on this sector in 2025, and geography decides which plant a listing strands. The date rests on the truce notice and on an export license approval rate that is not published.

what_would_change_this: If the truce is renewed at its notice date and no listing names the plant or its suppliers, this future fades. A listing that names cold heads before logic parts moves the first failure to the cold head and delays it by a quarter. If the Gulf route reopens, this future affects only one hemisphere.

name: A part is cut off and sealed magnets end the helium limit
sentence: Sealed magnets take most new builds while export controls restrict trade. The stop falls on the cold head, which now keeps every magnet cold.
what_happens: The truce lapses and the first measures are tariffs and a listing on control logic that the China plant absorbs with stock raised after the notice. The Gulf route reopens and helium becomes a cost line. Sealed magnets take most new builds and a 3 tesla clearance arrives by 2028. United States hospitals defer orders in 2027 and the OEM slips down its suppliers' queues. The cold-head maker's parent, for whom MR is a minority of revenue, fills its order book with fusion, physics and quantum work, and a producer-country notice lists 4 kelvin cryocoolers as dual use, closing the licence route for the China plant just as Europe's replacement orders rise.

path.sentence: The truce lapses, tariffs and a logic listing are absorbed with stock, the Gulf route reopens, sealed magnets take most new builds and a 3 tesla clearance arrives by 2028 while United States hospitals defer orders.

The cold-head maker's parent allocates capacity to better-paying buyers, a producer-country notice lists cryocoolers as dual use, and Europe's replacement peak lands on a line with no cold heads and no helium fallback.

what_fails_first.sentence: Cold heads fail first. The parent company of the only qualified maker gives its capacity to buyers who pay more, an export-control listing removes the license route, and every magnet shipped or in the field depends on the part.
what_fails_first.tag: AI-suggested; Engineering confirms the maker's location and ownership, Sourcing confirms the parent's MR share

how_soon: The failure comes by 2029. Lead times pass 30 days within a quarter of the parent's allocation letter, and a second maker takes 18 months to qualify, so the gap runs into 2030.
what_it_costs: Both plants stop for more than 30 days, for most of 18 months. Every install in the backlog runs more than 30 days late, installed sealed magnets miss their service commitments because they warm up without a spare cold head, and the delays fall on the European replacement peak, so market share moves to competitors. This is the most expensive of the four futures.
what_prevents_it: Engineering and Sourcing qualify a second cold-head maker before 2029, which means starting by the second quarter of 2027. Sourcing signs a multi-year supply agreement with the parent company in the 2027 sourcing cycle.

how_sure.basis: the single source, the parent's revenue mix and the 18-month requalification come from round 1 of the panel's research, and eight of the 11 panel members point to the cold head as the first to fail. The date rests on an allocation nobody has announced and an export-control listing that does not exist yet.

what_would_change_this: A producer-country notice naming wire before cryocoolers (a related cooling part) moves the first failure to the wire. If no 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared by 2028, this future merges into Future 3. If the parent company announces the sale or closure of the cold-head plant, the date moves to the announcement.
